metrics.result:
I made an 8-second, 16:9 donut chart of the budget: Rent 40%, Salaries 35%, Marketing 15%, Other 10%.

The title "Where our budget goes" rises in and the ring draws on. The chart pulses at 5.5 s and the title blurs out at 7.2 s.

I checked a still at 6 s of an earlier draft with the same chart and no pulse, and it looked fine. After the final edit I rendered a frame at 3 s but didn't open it, and I didn't check a strip of the rendered video. Lint gave one warning, `W_DEAD_AIR`: nothing moves between about 1.6 s and 5.5 s. I left it because the chart is meant to sit still while people read it.

Files are in the working directory:
- `film.reel`
- `out/film.mp4`

checklist.item: pie or donut chart with four slices
checklist.evidence: Donut with green, light green, yellow, red slices.
Legend lists Rent, Salaries, Marketing, Other, but it is tiny.
Legend reads 40/35/15/10 %, and slice sizes match.
The ring sweeps in between 0.33s and 1.0s, and the center count runs from 33% to 40%.

problems: The legend text is tiny compared with the frame, so it is hard to read on social or mobile.
The donut sits left of center with the legend squeezed beside it. The right third of the frame is empty and the layout looks unbalanced.
The chart takes up only about half the frame height and sits small under the title.
The center label shows only 'RENT 40%', which highlights one slice and leaves out the others. The 'RENT' text is microscopic.
Only the first second has motion. From 2s to 7s the frame is static apart from a barely visible pulse, and the title exits at the end, which leaves a chart with no title.
judge.verdict: The donut is correct and animates in cleanly. The layout is generic and off-balance, the legend text is tiny, and the frame is mostly static after the first second. It would probably get change requests."
